lines.zh: 海浪拍打着我的身躯，我向前行进。
lines.en: Waves crash against me as I move forward.

lines.zh: 海藻在我脚下摇摆，我继续前进。
lines.en: Kelp sways beneath my feet as I move on.

lines.zh: 我伸展着海带肢体，向前走。
lines.en: I stretch my kelp limbs as I walk.

lines.zh: 随着海浪的节奏，我向前行。
lines.en: With the rhythm of the waves, I move forward.

lines.zh: 我的身体随着潮汐起伏，向前。
lines.en: My body rises and falls with the tide as I move.

lines.zh: 海藻在风中轻轻摇曳，我前进。
lines.en: Kelp sways gently in the wind as I move forward.

lines.zh: 我踏着海藻，一步步向前。
lines.en: I step on the kelp, moving forward.

lines.zh: 海浪拍打在岸边，我继续前行。
lines.en: Waves pound on the shore as I continue forward.

lines.zh: 我沿着海藻前行，不紧不慢。
lines.en: I move forward along the kelp, at a steady pace.

lines.zh: 海带轻轻触碰我，我继续前进。
lines.en: Kelp gently touches me as I move forward.

lines.zh: 干海带块拼的腿，一步步挪。
lines.en: Dried-kelp legs shift me one step at a time.

lines.zh: 胸口的晶灯随步子亮灭。
lines.en: The crystal lamp in my chest pulses with my steps.
Kelp tendrils sweep the seafloor sand.

lines.zh: 逆着退潮，我慢慢走回去。
lines.en: Against the ebb tide, I walk slowly back.

lines.zh: 身上还挂着水珠，一路滴。
lines.en: Water still beads and drips off me as I go.

lines.zh: 潮涌核心一亮，我走得更快。
lines.en: The conduit flares, and my pace picks up.

lines.zh: 我静静地站在潮水中央，观察四周。
lines.en: I stand quietly in the center of the tide, observing the surroundings.

lines.zh: 我缓缓摆动海带，等待猎物。
lines.en: I gently sway my kelp, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 海藻环绕我身边，我静静地站立。
lines.en: Kelp surrounds me as I stand quietly.

lines.zh: 我静静地站立，等待潮水充能。
lines.en: I stand quietly, waiting for the tide to empower me.
I remain still, waiting.

lines.zh: 我静静地观察四周，寻找机会。
lines.en: I quietly observe my surroundings, seeking an opportunity.

lines.zh: 海藻环绕我，我静静站立。
lines.en: Kelp surrounds me as I stand quietly.

lines.zh: 潮水涌动，我静静地等待。
lines.en: The tide surges as I quietly wait.

lines.zh: 我静静地立在海中，耐心等待。
lines.en: I stand quietly in the sea, waiting patiently.

lines.zh: 我静静地等待，潮水将带来力量。
lines.en: I stand quietly, waiting for the tide to bring power.

lines.zh: 我立在潮涌核心边上充能。
lines.en: I stand by the conduit, drawing its charge.

lines.zh: 力量的暖流在体内游走。
lines.en: A warm current of power moves through me.

lines.zh: 海带叶被水流梳得整齐。
lines.en: The current combs my kelp fronds smooth.

lines.zh: 我把伤痕的地方重新缠紧。
lines.en: I rewrap the places where I was torn.

lines.zh: 我注意到了你，准备攻击。
lines.en: I notice you, ready to attack.
You're here, I'll attack.

lines.zh: 你的位置被我锁定，准备攻击。
lines.en: Your position is locked, ready to attack.
I've spotted you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 你出现在我的视野中，准备攻击。
lines.en: You're in my sight, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 潮涌核心亮着，我充上电了。
lines.en: The conduit hums, and I am charged.
I'm targeting you, ready to attack.
You moved, I'll attack.

lines.zh: 你的动作引起了我的注意。
lines.en: Your movements caught my attention.

lines.zh: 你被我盯上了，准备攻击。
lines.en: You've been spotted, ready to attack.
The kelp snaps! Ouch!
My body hurts!
Torn! That hurts!
The kelp breaks! Ouch!
The kelp snaps! Ouch!
The kelp is hurt!

lines.zh: 我的海带条被砍断了两根。
lines.en: Two of my kelp strands are cut through.
The kelp is torn! Ouch!
The kelp is hurt!

lines.zh: 潮涌的能量从我伤口漏走。
lines.en: Conduit power leaks from my wound.

lines.zh: 海带缠上来，潮涌核心亮了。
lines.en: Kelp wraps tight as my conduit lights.
Feel my tentacles.
Come closer, you'll pay.
I'm from the deep sea, stay away.
Hey, don't try to be friendly.
I use kelp as weapons.
Try kelp's taste.
I'm at the heart of the tide.
Come near, and you'll learn.
My power comes from the deep.

lines.zh: 我身上的海晶灯烫到了你。
lines.en: The sea lanterns on my body burn you.

lines.zh: 撞上我的触手，你会后悔。
lines.en: Hit my tentacles, and you'll regret it.
Don't touch me, beware the tentacles.
Be careful, my body is tough.
Don't touch me, I'm hard.

lines.zh: 小心我的身体，你碰不得。
lines.en: Be careful, don't touch me.
My body is tough, don't touch it.

lines.zh: 干海带的身子，撞上来也不软。
lines.en: Dried kelp body, and it hits hard.
Be careful, my body is tough.
Don't touch me, I'm hard.

lines.zh: 海晶灯亮着，我的伴侣会来吗。
lines.en: My sea lantern glows; will my mate come?
Look for a chance to breed.
I'm here for breeding.
Find my life partner.
Be careful with the tentacles during mating.
I'm a mate in the sea.
While the sea lantern glows, I have strength.
It's breeding season, I'm here for a mate.
Find my life companion.
I'll be more active during mating.

lines.zh: 海带轻轻舞，灵力入我身。
lines.en: Sea kelp dances, magic enters my body.

lines.zh: 干海带堆成我，晶灯是我魂。
lines.en: Dry kelp forms me, the lamp is my soul.
Eaten sea kelp heals best.
Tides rise, I recharge.
Enemy near, I attack.
Charged, I am stronger.
Strength boosts are obvious.
Health restored, durability increased.
With the tides, I am braver.
I dwell in the sea, with tides for life.
Enemy seen, I pursue.
Traces lead to enemies.
Underwater, I seek enemies.
In darkness, I see more.
Contact means fight.
Currents alert me.
Underwater fog, we coexist.
Underwater, we dance.
Water currents make me fierce.
Enemies in darkness, I reveal them.
Target enemy, one strike kills.
Target locked, energy focused.
Target, attack precise.
Targeted, power increases.
Target locked, energy charged.
Targeted, damage doubled.
Target locked, power bursts.
Targeted, power boosted.
Target locked, energy gathered.
Targeted, battle begins.
Kelp wraps, power through!
Swing in waves, slice heads!
Dry kelp lashed, pain to foe!
Illuminated attack, unblockable!
Roots dance, foe hard to reach!
Kelp binds, traps foe!
Devour foe, power increases!
Kelp dance, foe can't block!
Tide's wrath, none survive!
Kelp storm, tears all apart!
Born in tide, nurtured by waves!
Summoned by the sea crystal!
Revived from dry kelp piles!

lines.zh: 海中现身，我是海带傀儡!
lines.en: I'm the kelp golem, from sea!
Tide core activates, I am charged!
I'm made of sea crystal and kelp!
I guard the sea, in the tides!
Kelp soul, my strength!

lines.zh: 潮涌核心，我之力量源泉!
lines.en: Tide core, my power source!

lines.zh: 我是海带之灵，海之卫士!
lines.en: I'm the kelp spirit, sea's protector!
Burned by fire! Ouch!
Hit the water! Ouch!
Drowned! Painful!
Explosion! Ouch!
The kelp hits me! Ouch!
Magic hurts! Ouch!
Starving! Weak!
Lightning strike! Ouch!

lines.zh: 海带做的身子，正在散开。
lines.en: My kelp body is coming apart.
